description: Recommend plugins first, then skills. With based_on set to a skill's owner/name slug, returns up to 3 plugins (the plugins that skill belongs to, then featured plugins in its category; items have type "plugin", slug owner/name, title, description, url, skills, featured) followed by the top skills in that skill's category (excluding itself); without it, returns the featured plugins followed by what is trending over the last 30 days.

based_on.description: Skill slug (owner/name) to base recommendations on

name: skillmd_recommend

items.description: A skill as listed in search and leaderboard results.

ai_audit_verdict.description: Safety review verdict: pass, caution, warning, fail or inconclusive

description.description: What the skill does and when an agent should use it

repo_stars.description: GitHub stars of the source repository

security_flags.description: Capability flags: docs_only, network_calls, executes_scripts, reads_secrets, untrusted_install
